summary: Epsium Enterprise Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Ming Yin Gordan Au Yeung for personal reasons, effective April 30, 2026, with no disagreement with management. The board immediately appointed Ching Wan Wong as new CFO, effective May 1, 2026, who has over 25 years of finance and SEC compliance experience. Wong will receive annual compensation of USD 10,000, payable monthly, under an Officer and Director Agreement with indemnification provisions. The filing is a routine management change disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. Watch for any subsequent operational updates under new CFO leadership.
